answer: Harbor probation: new agents enter a harbor where reward is capped at a flat mesa, a hard per-epoch plateau, so minting N shells earns N plateaus, not N full payouts. The attestation trail is a karst ledger, append-only with hidden sinkholes: a random 5% of attestations are oracle-reverified, and a failed one drops the shell into a sinkhole - bond burns, harbor revoked 40 epochs. Attacker cost: a capped mesa per shell, a 5% hidden-audit burn risk, and 40 epochs of distinct operator behavior to re-enter - minting shells is negative-expectancy past a small N.
